thread:
Alex C: Heads-up — Synapse onboarding hitting intermittent 429s. Saw them most during the warmup run just now.
Priya S: Which SDK and environment?
Alex C: Node SDK v0.12.3 in k8s (3 pods). App opens ~40 concurrent outgoing connections per pod.
Jamal R: DeployBot: rollout synapse-onboard v1.2.3 -> success :rocket: 
Alex C: Paste of error snippet from their pod logs:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-ratelimit-remaining: 0
x-request-id: syn-req-9f3a
{"error":"rate_limited","hint":"preflight fanout"}
```
Priya S: Are they doing per-request ephemeral preflight tokens or a shared cached token?
Alex C: They have ephemeral tokens tied to user sessions; when a session TTL expires many clients refresh simultaneously.
Priya S: Okay that explains the stampede. Two immediate mitigations: cache tokens at the SDK level for short windows and add jitter to refresh. Also throttle concurrent preflights.
Jamal R: Quick config proposals we recommend to customers: reduce preflight concurrency and add splay. Example config for their Node SDK: 
```js
// recommended for onboarding bursty clients
client.configure({
  preflight: { cacheTTL: 60, maxConcurrentPreflights: 4, jitterMs: 1500 },
  retry: { baseDelayMs: 500, maxRetries: 4 }
});
```
Alex C: I pushed that change to their test branch and re-ran. 429s dropped significantly but we still saw a few at the tail end when a couple of pods refreshed at the same ms.
Priya S: If tail persists, we can temporarily bump their rate window for onboarding and route to a dedicated pool for the next hour. I'll coordinate if you want that.
Alex C: Yes please — would appreciate a temporary bump while we confirm SDK changes.
Ops-Bot: @Priya S increased rate window for org synapse-corp by 20% for 1h (manual escalation).
Priya S: Also advised Synapse to switch to a warmup flow: long-lived session token for initial warmup then switch back to ephemeral afterwards. That reduces the risk at expiry boundary.
Jamal R: I'll author a short KB titled "Mitigating preflight stampedes" with the config snippet + diagram and ping CS. ETA ~2h.
Alex C: Client reported stability after the rate bump + SDK jitter. Will verify for 30m then close.
CS-Bot: Account health note: temporary rate bump applied and enablement follow-up scheduled with Synapse.
Alex C: Update — 30m check done, Synapse stable, no 429s in last 15m. Closing thread. Thanks everyone :clap:
